profile_name: Ubuntu Local Municipality (Victoria West, Northern Cape)
_doc:
ONE bill shape, 9 PDFs, one account. Ubuntu Local Municipality (Victoria West,
Northern Cape) bills Telkom TFMC account [number removed] (old account 050321/002321) for
ELECTRICITY and WATER on the same "Sebata" ledger statement, Sep 2025 - Jul 2026.

FINGERPRINT: "4870197581" - Ubuntu's OWN municipality VAT registration, printed in the
masthead as "Municipality VAT Nr: 4870197581". Checked against all 487 PDFs in the
Telkom tree: it occurs in exactly 9 files, all of them this folder, and in no other
folder. Four other folders share this identical print stream (Joe Gqabi 15 files,
Tokologo 10, Nama Khoi 4, George 2) and every one of them carries a DIFFERENT
municipality VAT number (4280128101 / 4000846479 / 4890198585 / 4630193664), so the VAT
number is the one marker that cannot cross-route. Do NOT fingerprint on the shared
strings "Computer Generated Tax Invoice for", "Municipality VAT Nr", "Total Amount(B)"
or "Tariff: ..." (40 files across 5 municipalities), nor on the addressee block
(Tfmc / Private Bag X 137 / Centurion / Telkom's own VAT 4680101146).

FILE NAMING / "UBU_388": the folder holds six UBU_3280_3280*.pdf, two
UBU_3280_AccountStatement - <ISO>.pdf and one UBU_388_AccountStatement - <ISO>.pdf.
The UBU_388_ prefix is a FILENAME ERROR, not a second account: inside that PDF the
printed identifiers are Account No. [number removed], Invoice No. 3280/2026/03/05, Old
Account No. 050321/002321, Property Id [number removed], Reference Nr [number removed] -
byte-for-byte the same account as the other eight, and it is simply the February-2026
statement that is otherwise missing from the monthly sequence. No "388" appears anywhere
in its text. All 9 files therefore extract with account_number [number removed].

LAYOUT. Page 1: masthead ("Ubuntu Municipality", Tel [number removed], [address removed],
CHURCH STREET Victoria West 7070) + "Computer Generated Tax Invoice for: <Month>
<Year>" + Account/Invoice/Old-Account block + addressee + a Property Id / SG Number /
Town/Suburb / Days grid + a per-service summary table with three money columns
Amount(excl.Vat) | Vat | Amount(Incl.Vat). Service rows actually used:
"Electricity Basic", "Electricity Metered", "Water Basic", "Water Metered" and
sometimes "Journals" (a system reversal of a previous estimate). Then
"VAT Services <base>", "Total Amount(B)", "Total Amount Payable(A+B)", an aging strip
(90+ Days / 30-90 Days / Total charge (excluding VAT) / Total VAT / Total Charge
(including VAT)), Due Date + Amount Payable, and the payment stub.
Pages 2..n: the transaction detail. Each charge is a block
    <dd/mm/yyyy> <description>                       R ex     R vat     R incl
                 [Cur <reading> Prev <reading> Cons <qty> KWH|KL]
                 [Meter *01*050321*40 [(Estimate)]]
                   Factor / Levy Estimate Reason / Dwelling Units
                 <qty> x <rate> = <amount>            (one line per tariff step)
                 [Meter Transaction / Meter Connection Size: 1 - 1]
                     Tariff: ELEC BASIC-COMMERCIAL | COMMERCIAL-USEAGE ONLY |
                             WATER BASIC-RESIDENTIAL | WATER BASIC-COMMERCIAL |
                             WATER RESIDENTIAL
The trailing "Tariff:" line is the ONLY reliable service discriminator in the detail, so
every detail rule walks from its charge line to its own Tariff line through the tempered
token (?:(?!^[ \t]*\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})[\s\S])*? - it can never run past its own
block into the next transaction, and it survives the repeated page header/footer
("Date Details (R)Amount(excl.Vat)..." / "Print Date: ... Page:n of m") that sits between
blocks. Meter rules use the same trick against ^Meter (and tolerate the "Meter
Transaction" / "Meter Connection Size" lines, which start with the same word).

SECTIONS. "electricity" starts at the page-1 "Electricity Basic" summary row; "water" is
declared as an OVERLAY starting at the page-1 "Water Basic" row. Both spans therefore run
to the end of the document and overlap - deliberate, because the elec and water detail
blocks are INTERLEAVED on pages 2..n and a contiguous-span split would put every
electricity reading inside the water section. Cross-contamination is prevented by the
rules themselves: electricity rules require KWH / Tariff: ELEC / Tariff: COMMERCIAL,
water rules require KL / Tariff: WATER.

MONEY. Space thousands + dot decimal (R 22 802.52), credits in accountant parentheses
((R 9 693.32)), a bare "-" where a column is nil. There is NO comma-decimal money
anywhere in this folder, so the _to_decimal comma-as-thousands 100x trap does not apply
here. clean_value/_to_decimal handles both the parentheses and the "-".

ELECTRICITY MAPPING AND RULE ZERO. The bill prints no independent electricity-only
ex-VAT subtotal. total_ex_vat_r is therefore the SUM of the three printed electricity
summary rows (Electricity Basic + Electricity Metered + Journals) and other_r is
Electricity Basic + Journals, so the reconcile check (parts == total) is STRUCTURALLY
CIRCULAR on this profile and proves nothing on its own. Stated openly, as Rule Zero
requires. The genuine checks used instead are:
 (1) elec Basic + elec Metered + Journals + water Basic + water Metered == the
     independently printed "Total Amount(B)" ex-VAT column  (exact on 9/9 bills);
 (2) the printed "Total Amount(B)" VAT column == 15% of the printed "VAT Services"
     base                                                    (max 1c on 9/9 bills);
 (3) the DETAIL charge lines summed per tariff == the page-1 summary rows, the residue
     being exactly the "Interest - Interest on Overdue Balance/Late Payment" lines the
     municipality books against each tariff (natives ubu_energy_r / ubu_basic_levy_r /
     ubu_water_levy_r / ubu_water_usage_r / ubu_interest_r) - this is a real, non-circular
     test of the detail extraction;
 (4) sum(end readings) - sum(start readings) == sum(Cons ... KWH)  (exact on 9/9).

standard_r is the printed "Electricity Metered" row, which is the municipality's own
attribution and therefore INCLUDES the interest it books against the usage tariff
(e.g. UBU_3280_3280-TFMC: 7 284.29 energy + 1 473.74 interest = 8 758.03). The pure
energy figure is available separately as ubu_energy_r. Interest cannot be split by
service from the text: the interest lines carry no Tariff line of their own and are not
positionally adjacent to the tariff they belong to (in UBU_3280_3280-TFMC the R1 473.74
interest line sits between the ELEC BASIC levy and the WATER BASIC levy yet belongs to
Electricity Metered), so no rule attempts it.

Single-band tariff: "COMMERCIAL-USEAGE ONLY" is a flat kWh tariff with a stepped rate
(2 000 kWh @ 3.7939 then the balance @ 3.7056 on the July 2026 bill), NOT time-of-use.
Its consumption and Rands route to the STANDARD band, the same single-band convention
CoJ flat-rate / Ekurhuleni / KwaDukuza use. peak/offpeak/nmd and demand columns are
mapped "_none": Ubuntu prints NO kVA anywhere in this folder (zero occurrences of "KVA"
in all 9 files) and no TOU split.

MULTI-PERIOD BILLS. Several statements bill two consecutive KWH periods at once
(UBU_3280_3280: 30/06->15/07 and 19/05->30/06; the Nov statement: 30/09->10/10 and
15/08->30/09). Readings, Cons, days and detail Rands are all collect:"sum"; the reading
registers self-check (e.g. 51969.000+50427.158 - 50427.158-46110.000 = 5 859.000 =
1 541.842+4 317.158). The detail blocks are printed NEWEST FIRST, so read_end takes the
FIRST "Cur" date and read_start takes the LAST "Prev" date (its pattern uses a greedy
^[\s\S]* prefix to land on the last KWH block); on the Nov statement that yields
15/08/2025 -> 10/10/2025, exactly the 56 days the two blocks' day counts add up to.

ESTIMATES. Meter lines carry an optional "(Estimate)" suffix -> reading_type. It is
printed on the electricity meter on 1 of 9 bills (UBU_3280_3280-TFMC, Sep 2025) and on
the water meter on 9 of 9, so blank electricity reading_type on the other 8 is the
bill's silence. Estimates are later reversed as the "Journals" row ("System Reversal
(Estimation of nnnn.000000 KWH)"), which is negative and is captured with its
parentheses.
Some electricity usage is billed WITHOUT reading dates ("<date> Dwelling Units: 1
R 6 238.29 ... 1,439.052533 x 4.335000 = 6238.29" under COMMERCIAL-USEAGE ONLY) - that
is the estimated slice of a period whose remainder is billed on the following
reading-dated line, and the kWh is ALREADY inside that line's "Cons" figure
(1 439.052533 + 102.789467 = 1 541.842), so it must NOT be added to total_kwh. Its Rands
ARE part of Electricity Metered and are captured by the generic charge rule.

WATER. Water is billed on meter *01*050321*41 in KL with a stepped residential tariff and
has been on estimate since 12/03/2024 ("Levy Estimate Reason: Meter clocked over",
871-day period, a constant 47.000 KL). Water fields are native (ubu_water_*) and land on
the water row; the canonical 28-column template is electricity-only.

Deposit / Guarantee: printed as literal 0.00 / 0 in the page-1 "Cycle, Meter book &
Route" grid, i.e. no security is held - deposit_r/cash_r/guarantee_r/security_held_r are
mapped "_none".
No scans: read_pdf(ocr="auto") reports ocr:False scanned:False on all 9 files (2-7 pages,
8.8k-34k chars of real text), so ocr stays at the app default.
